basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old tech enthusiast living in Auckland, New Zealand. Recently graduated with a degree in computer science, I'm currently working as a junior software developer. I have a passion for exploring new technologies and a keen interest in the dynamics of cryptocurrency. In my downtime, I enjoy watching tech-centric shows like Silicon Valley and diving into the world of gaming with titles like Dawn of War. I'm fairly new to the Reddit community and still navigating my way around. I'm single and love spending my weekends exploring local cafes and tech meetups. I'm usually online during the evenings after work and often browse Reddit late into the night.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in computer science, having completed my degree at the University of Auckland. My knowledge is largely academic, but I'm actively applying what I've learned in my current job as a software developer. I'm also self-taught in some areas of cryptocurrency, which I find fascinating and continue to explore through online resources and community discussions.
